claims.text: Nickel-based superalloys can be used to prepare or coat parts of hot-dip aluminum plating equipment.
Ceramic coatings can be applied to parts of hot-dip aluminum plating equipment.
Nickel-based superalloys protect equipment components from erosion by high-temperature liquid aluminum.
Ceramic coatings protect equipment components from erosion by high-temperature liquid aluminum.
Sinking rollers, pulling rollers, and guide plates are conventionally made from materials lacking enhanced corrosion resistance.
Changing the component material or adding a coating changes the material composition relevant to degradation.
The proposed nickel-based superalloy or ceramic coating has enhanced corrosion resistance.
The proposed nickel-based superalloy or ceramic coating has enhanced high-temperature stability.
Enhanced corrosion resistance and high-temperature stability will reduce component corrosion during hot-dip aluminum plating.
Reduced corrosion will increase the service life of the equipment components.
The effectiveness of the nickel-based superalloy or ceramic coating may depend on its specific composition.
The effectiveness of the nickel-based superalloy or ceramic coating may depend on the application method.
